sections.title: In short
paragraphs: Questling also works without an account: in that case your data stays on your device only and is not sent to anyone.
There are no ads, no tracking, no analytics and no profiling.
An account is optional and is only used to sync your data across devices. You can delete it at any time from the app: your cloud data is erased immediately.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: Controller: Enrico Stefanello.
Contact for privacy questions: enricostefanello0@gmail.com.

sections.title: Without an account: data on your device
paragraphs: The app stores on your device the name you choose, your hero, your quiz answers, the quests you write, your completions, your experience (XP) and your settings.
This data never leaves your device. Notifications are scheduled locally by your phone: they do not go through any server.
You can export it to a backup file (Settings, Export backup) or delete it (Settings, Delete all local data). Uninstalling the app removes it from the device.

sections.title: With an account (optional): data we process
paragraphs: If you create an account or sign in, we process: your email address and a user identifier (UID) generated by the sign-in service; the name you chose for your hero, the hero itself and your quiz answers; the quests you wrote, your completions and your experience (XP) events.

If you sign in with Google or Apple we only receive your account identifier and email from them, never your password. If you use email and password, the password is handled by the authentication service and is not visible to us.
We do not sync device settings (notification times, sounds, vibration).

To sign in with Google or Apple on the phone app, the official Google and Apple libraries are used, which may process data under their own policies. If you do not use these sign-in methods (or do not create an account) they are not used.

sections.title: Providers and data location
paragraphs: For the account and syncing we use Google's Firebase (Authentication and Cloud Firestore). Google acts as a processor on our behalf.
Data region: Europe (the Cloud Firestore database is hosted in a European region).
Any transfers to countries outside the EU take place with the safeguards required by law (standard contractual clauses): [TO COMPLETE: check Google's current terms before publishing].

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis
paragraphs: We use account data only to provide the service you asked for by creating the account: signing in and syncing your data between your devices (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
We do not use your data for marketing, advertising or profiling, and we do not sell it or pass it to third parties.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Cloud data stays for as long as your account exists. From Account, Delete account, we immediately delete your account and all your cloud data.
Data on your device stays until you delete it or uninstall the app: deleting the account does not erase it (you can do that separately in Settings).
Any residual technical copies held by the provider are removed according to its own technical timelines: [TO COMPLETE: check the timelines stated by Google].

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask for access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection to processing. You can do many of these yourself in the app: edit your data, export a backup in JSON format, delete the account.

For any request write to the contact above. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your data protection authority (in Italy, the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali, garanteprivacy.it).

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: The app is not aimed at children. If you are under 14, use it with the consent of a parent or guardian. [TO COMPLETE: check the applicable minimum age before publishing].

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Communication with the cloud is encrypted. Access rules let each user read and write only their own data.
Data saved on the device is not encrypted by the app: it is protected by your phone's lock.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we change the way we process data we will update this page and the date at the top. For significant changes we will let you know in the app.
